Test: country and province centroids

Source: R/clean.R, R/test-docs.R
test_centroid.Rd

Flags records within 1 km of a country or province centroid (WGS84 geodesic distance, closed ball), where records georeferenced to a country or province name end up. The default gazetteer contains the country points of the three sources CoordinateCleaner's table is compiled from, each taken from the source: the "Geographic coordinates" of the CIA World Factbook (public domain; 275 points, through the factbook.json mirror retrieved 2026-10-11), the label points of the thematicmapping.org World Borders Dataset 0.3 (Bjorn Sandvik, CC BY-SA; 246 points), and every point the GEOLocate georeferencing service (geo-locate.org) returns for a country name, queried 2026-10-11 (548 points; a place of that name more than 100 km away inside another country is left out). Province centroids are the Natural Earth 5.1.1 admin-1 label points (4,594), the current release of the layer CoordinateCleaner's province centroids come from. The column extension marks the 516 Natural Earth country polygon centroids and label points, which CoordinateCleaner's table does not hold; passing the points with extension FALSE as gazetteers = list(centroid = ...) leaves them out.

Usage

clean_centroid(x, buffer = 1000, ...)

Arguments

x

A data frame of occurrence records.

buffer

Buffer distance of the test, in the unit of its Buffer section; the default is the test's default buffer.

...

Further arguments to flag_occurrences(): columns, reference, gazetteers, land_scale.

Value

clean_<test>(): the rows of x the test does not flag, with the columns of x unchanged. See keep_unflagged(), Cleaning functions.

Fields

lon, lat.

Buffer

buffers = list(centroid = 1000), in metres.

CoordinateCleaner

Equivalent to cc_cen() with test = "both". Its 72-gon buffer edge lies within 0.95 m of the 1 km circle. Of its 660 country centroids, 645 are points of the default gazetteer at distance 0. Of the other 15, India, Italy and the United Kingdom hold World Borders values that version 0.3 of the dataset changed; three GEOLocate points for Macedonia and one for Guinea, at sea at 10 W 5 N, are not returned by GEOLocate today; eight (Aland, Caribbean Netherlands, DR Congo, Kuwait, Martinique, Monaco, Saint Martin, San Marino) lie 5 m to 68 km from a default point. Its province centroids are the admin-1 label points of older Natural Earth releases (4,566 of 4,645 rows match release 3.3.0, 4.0.0 or 4.1.0 exactly); 4,591 are default points at distance 0, and 50 lie more than 10 km from any, where Natural Earth has since changed the unit or the row matches no tagged release.

Custom gazetteer

gazetteers = list(centroid = points), a data frame of longitude and latitude; see flag_occurrences().

See also

flag_occurrences(), flag_tests(), reference_info()

Other tests: clean_age_equal(), clean_age_outlier(), clean_age_range_outlier(), clean_aohi(), clean_basis_fossil(), clean_capital(), clean_country_mismatch(), clean_dataset_ddmm(), clean_dataset_rounded(), clean_duplicate(), clean_equal(), clean_establishment_introduced(), clean_gbif_headquarters(), clean_institution(), clean_invalid(), clean_issue_coordinate(), clean_outlier(), clean_range(), clean_sea(), clean_sea_nonmarine(), clean_spatiotemporal_outlier(), clean_urban(), clean_zero()

Examples

x <- data.frame(decimalLongitude = c(14.1307, 10), decimalLatitude = c(47.5857, 50))
flag_occurrences(x, tests = "centroid")$flag_centroid
g <- reference_points("centroid")
flag_occurrences(x, tests = "centroid",
                 gazetteers = list(centroid = g[!g$extension, ]))$flag_centroid
clean_centroid(x)
